manifest.author: w2r-plugins contributors
manifest.description: Logs a line when it loads. A template for new plugins.
manifest.name: Hello Example

manifest.author: Luxray997 (ported by Beau Hastings)
manifest.description: In-match chat history with channels and player colours (port of wc2r-plus chat.cpp by Luxray997).
manifest.name: Chat

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Shows the lobby's map preview (terrain, gold mines, start locations) over a running match. Press the backslash key to open and close it.
manifest.name: In-game Map Preview

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Pick OBS as your team in the lobby to watch a game instead of playing: you see the whole map and are not counted as defeated. Every player in the game needs this plugin.
manifest.name: Observer

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Shows one box per player in their color in the top bar, to the right of your food count. Boxes disappear when a player leaves or is defeated, and a divider separates the teams.
manifest.name: Player Color Bar

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Adds a Random map button to the Create Multiplayer Game screen, with a slider to only pick maps for a chosen number of players.
manifest.name: Random Map

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Remembers the game speed, resources, units, tileset and starting location of the last game you created and fills them in the next time you open the Create Multiplayer Game screen.
manifest.name: Remember Game Settings
